channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Opinion | Andrew Sorrell, campaign cash, and the quiet shutdown of Stable Revolution
item.description: How the state auditor’s consulting firm, PAC finances, disclosure failures, and dissolution expose loopholes rewarding legal compliance while undermining trust.

item.title: Advocates to rally at Alabama Statehouse for Reproductive Justice Advocacy Day
item.description: Advocates, educators, and families are gathering at the Alabama Statehouse, urging lawmakers to oppose Senate Bill 3 and protect sexual health education.

item.title: Alabama achieves record $14.6 billion in economic development investment
item.description: Alabama's strategic economic development plan delivered historic results in 2025, attracting $14.6 billion in capital investment and nearly 9,400 new job commitments.

item.title: Gov. Ivey pushes for more veterans to teach in Alabama classrooms
item.description: Lawmakers officially filed Senate Bill 149 Tuesday, creating a temporary certificate pathway for eligible veterans lacking a bachelor's degree.

item.title: Senate unanimously advances bill aligning sickle cell commission with ADPH
item.description: The Senate unanimously passed bill extending sickle cell commission and placing it within the Department of Public Health to expand statewide access.

item.title: Alabama Senate advances bill to restrict environmental regulation expansion
item.description: The controversial bill, which prohibits state agencies from setting environmental standards stricter than federal law, passed committee 5-2 after heated debate.

item.title: House Democratic Caucus makes affordability center of 2026 agenda
item.description: The Alabama House Democratic Caucus unveiled its 2026 legislative priorities Tuesday, focusing on tax elimination, voting access, and public education funding.

item.title: Opinion | A legislative agenda we should all support
item.description: Sometimes, a good idea is just a good idea, no matter who proposes it.

item.title: Local educator Craig Jelks officially launches independent bid for US Senate
item.description: Disillusioned with both major parties, the career educator announced he was running as an independent to represent everyday Alabamians.

item.title: Analysis | How a Tuberville residency challenge would unfold in party, Legislature
item.description: Alabama law puts post-election eligibility disputes in the hands of lawmakers, not judges, with major consequences for succession and democratic legitimacy.
